__HOW TO PLAY__

1. Make 2 teams.

2. Team 1 chooses a player from their team to draw.

3. After the drawing players sees their word and is ready to draw, tap “Start Timer”.

4. The player starts drawing and Team 1 has 60 seconds to guess the word that is being drawn. The drawing player cannot say any words or act out the word or phrase.

5.  If Team 1 guesses correctly before the buzzer sounds they win the point.

6. If Team 1 does not guess the word or phrase, Team 2 has 10 seconds to steal. Team 2 only gets one guess. If Team 2 guesses correctly, they win the point.

7. Repeat steps 2 to 6 with Team 2 drawing. Continue alternating back and forth (with a new player drawing each time). The first to 7 points wins!
